name: appearance
description: One Material theme: the light and the dark theme show the same chrome, and the selected tab and the settings button read in both.

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('theme'); field.value = 'light'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return field.value;
steps.why: the theme is changed to light
the app has a moment to apply the theme
the chrome wears the light theme
the settings button lights up while the settings tab is in front

steps.expression: const active = document.querySelector('#tabs button.active'); const gear = document.getElementById('settings'); const tab = getComputedStyle(active); const button = getComputedStyle(gear); return button.backgroundColor === tab.borderBottomColor && button.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)';
steps.why: the settings button wears the accent colour, exactly like the selected tab
the app has a moment to open the tab

steps.expression: const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button:not(.plus)')]; const idle = tabs.find((tab) => !tab.classList.contains('active')); const active = tabs.find((tab) => tab.classList.contains('active')); return getComputedStyle(active).backgroundColor !== getComputedStyle(idle).backgroundColor;
steps.why: the selected tab is painted differently from the idle one in the light theme

steps.expression: const active = document.querySelector('#tabs button.active'); const style = getComputedStyle(active); return style.borderBottomWidth + ' ' + style.borderBottomColor;
steps.why: the selected tab carries a two pixel underline

steps.expression: const idle = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button:not(.plus)')].find((tab) => !tab.classList.contains('active')); const style = getComputedStyle(idle); return style.backgroundColor + ' | ' + style.color;
steps.why: the idle tab stays readable instead of disappearing into the strip

steps.title: Settings
steps.expression: const field = document.getElementById('theme'); field.value = 'dark'; field.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return field.value;
steps.why: the theme is changed to dark
the app has a moment to apply the theme
the chrome wears the dark theme

steps.expression: const tabs = [...document.querySelectorAll('#tabs button:not(.plus)')]; const idle = tabs.find((tab) => !tab.classList.contains('active')); const active = tabs.find((tab) => tab.classList.contains('active')); return getComputedStyle(active).backgroundColor !== getComputedStyle(idle).backgroundColor;
steps.why: the selected tab is painted differently from the idle one in the dark theme too
the settings tab is clicked again
the app has a moment to switch the tab

steps.expression: const active = document.querySelector('#tabs button.active'); const gear = document.getElementById('settings'); const tab = getComputedStyle(active); const button = getComputedStyle(gear); return button.backgroundColor === tab.borderBottomColor && button.backgroundColor !== 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)';
steps.why: the settings button wears the accent colour in the dark theme too
